headlines.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Department of Finance: Deepen industry-finance cooperation to serve new industrialization
headlines.summary_en: [Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Department of Finance: Deepen industry-finance cooperation to serve new industrialization] At the Shanghai Stock Exchange Global Investors Conference held today, a relevant official of the MIIT Department of Finance stated that since the 14th Five-Year Plan, industry-finance cooperation has been incorporated into more than 30 policies covering monetary, credit, and capital markets. To date, nearly 460,000 enterprises have registered on the national industry-finance cooperation platform, which has connected more than 3,100 financial institutions and over 850 financial products and embedded more than 50 industrial policies, helping enterprises raise over 1.8 trillion yuan in total financing, and has included manufacturing enterprise financing as a key item in the national "efficiently completing one thing" initiative.

headlines.title: 两部门：加大新型储能产业支持力度
headlines.summary: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，加大新型储能产业支持力度。引导民营企业与高校、科研院所等协同创新，支持民营企业参与新型储能领域科技重大专项评选和投资新型储能。用好新型政策性金融工具、制造业中长期贷款、地方政府专项债券等，支持符合条件的新型储能项目建设。鼓励金融机构加大对新型储能的绿色金融支持力度。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Step up support for the new energy storage industry
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes to increase support for the new-type energy storage industry. It calls for guiding private enterprises to collaborate on innovation with universities and research institutes, and supporting private enterprises in participating in major science and technology programs in the new-type energy storage field and in investing in new-type energy storage. It calls for making good use of new policy-based financial instruments, medium- and long-term loans for manufacturing, and local government special bonds to support the construction of qualifying new-type energy storage projects. It encourages financial institutions to increase green finance support for new-type energy storage.

headlines.title: 两部门：到2030年，全国新型储能装机规模达到3亿千瓦，平均储能时长3小时左右
headlines.summary: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，锚定2030年前碳达峰目标，建设能源强国，坚持高质量发展主线，统筹发展和安全，综合平衡各类电源、电网及调节能力的关系，巩固提升新型储能产业核心竞争力，全面支撑新型能源体系和新型电力系统建设。到2030年，新型储能由规模化发展阶段步入市场化发展阶段，全国新型储能装机规模达到3亿千瓦，平均储能时长3小时左右。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: By 2030, national new energy storage installed capacity to reach 300 million kilowatts, with average storage duration of about 3 hours
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes to anchor the goal of peaking carbon emissions before 2030, build an energy powerhouse, adhere to the main line of high-quality development, coordinate development and security, comprehensively balance the relationship among various power sources, power grids and regulation capabilities, consolidate and enhance the core competitiveness of the new-type energy storage industry, and fully support the building of a new energy system and a new power system. By 2030, new-type energy storage will move from the large-scale development stage to the market-based development stage, with nationwide installed new-type energy storage capacity reaching 300 million kilowatts and an average storage duration of about 3 hours.

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China consistently opposes abuse of export control measures that disrupt the stability of global industrial and supply chains
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning hosted a regular press conference. A Bloomberg reporter asked: First, according to our agency's report, Nvidia chips are currently appearing in data centers in Shanghai; what is the Foreign Ministry's comment? Second, US lawmakers and the Commerce Department are pushing to pass a chip act to prevent Chinese companies from obtaining US computing power through foreign channels; does China believe these restrictive measures violate the China-US trade truce? Given that the APEC summit is about to be held, how will China respond?

headlines.title_en: Exceeding 1 trillion yuan for 5 consecutive months; Guangdong's foreign trade in the first 10 months exceeds last year's full-year total
headlines.summary_en: The Guangdong Sub-Administration of the General Administration of Customs released the latest data: in the first 10 months of this year, Guangdong's foreign trade imports and exports totaled RMB 9.8 trillion, already exceeding the full-year scale of last year and up 25.7% year on year. Of this, exports were RMB 5.73 trillion, up 15.1%; imports were RMB 4.07 trillion, up 44.6%. In the first 10 months, Guangdong's foreign trade accounted for 21.9% of the national total, up 1 percentage point from the same period last year. It is understood that after historically exceeding the RMB 1 trillion mark for the first time in June this year, Guangdong's monthly imports and exports have remained above RMB 1 trillion for five consecutive months.

headlines.title: 两部门：鼓励超级电容、压缩二氧化碳储能、液态空气储能等技术试点应用
headlines.summary: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，科学布局新型储能创新方向。加快锂离子电池储能迭代升级，推广钠离子电池储能应用。推动压缩空气储能、液流电池储能、飞轮储能等从试点应用向商业化应用过渡。鼓励超级电容、压缩二氧化碳储能、液态空气储能、重力储能、熔盐储热等技术试点应用。支持固态电池、热泵储电、热储能、氢储能等前沿技术储备。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: encourage pilot applications of technologies such as supercapacitors, compressed CO2 energy storage, and liquid air energy storage
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes scientifically laying out innovative directions for new-type energy storage. Accelerate the iterative upgrading of lithium-ion battery storage and promote the application of sodium-ion battery storage. Drive compressed-air storage, flow battery storage, flywheel storage and others to transition from pilot applications to commercial applications. Encourage pilot applications of technologies such as supercapacitors, compressed CO2 storage, liquid air storage, gravity storage, and molten salt heat storage. Support the reservation of frontier technologies such as solid-state batteries, heat pump electricity storage, thermal storage, and hydrogen storage.

headlines.title: 无人机袭击削弱产能 俄罗斯经济显现增长放缓迹象
headlines.summary: 随着乌克兰的袭击导致工业设施瘫痪、物流受阻并加剧了通胀压力，俄罗斯经济正显现出增长放缓的迹象。根据机构对经济学家进行的调查，俄罗斯第三季度GDP同比增速预计为0.9%，低于前一季度1.3%的增幅。这种放缓态势与俄罗斯央行此前的警告相吻合，即无人机袭击正在削弱多个行业的生产能力。根据俄联邦统计局的数据，受炼油厂停产影响，第三季度炼油产量同比下降18%，创下自2020年以来季度数据的最大跌幅。燃料产量的减少加剧了采矿业的萎缩，并导致批发贸易陷入负增长。此外，乌方的袭击还破坏了装卸码头和港口基础设施，对出口造成了拖累。牛津经济研究院的Tatiana Orlov

headlines.title_en: Drone attacks weaken production capacity; Russian economy shows signs of slowing growth
headlines.summary_en: As Ukrainian attacks paralyze industrial facilities, disrupt logistics and intensify inflationary pressure, Russia's economy is showing signs of slowing growth. According to a survey of economists by institutions, Russia's Q3 GDP growth is expected at 0.9% year on year, down from 1.3% in the previous quarter. This slowdown is consistent with the Russian central bank's earlier warning that drone attacks are weakening production capacity in multiple industries. According to Federal State Statistics Service data, refinery output fell 18% year on year in Q3 due to refinery shutdowns, the largest quarterly decline since 2020. The reduction in fuel output has exacerbated the contraction in mining and pushed wholesale trade into negative growth. In addition, Ukrainian attacks have also damaged loading docks and port infrastructure, weighing on exports. Tatiana Orlov of Oxford Economics
